result.rationale: The diff shows refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response from CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT, while callers treat it as the provider SDK result. In googlecalendar, `const token = res?.data; googleCredentials.access_token = token.access_token` — a fetch Response has no `.data`, so sharing mode throws a TypeError. Similarly zoho-bigin/zohocrm do `tokenInfo.data.error` on an axios-shaped expectation, and hubspot's refreshAccessToken types the result as HubspotToken with `expires_in` used for expiry, all of which break when the generic Response is returned. judged_text: refreshOAuthTokens returns a raw fetch Response in sharing mode instead of SDK response shapes, crashing callers that unwrap provider-specific fields: googlecalendar (res?.data undefined → TypeError on token.access_token), zoho-bigin and zohocrm (tokenInfo.data.error TypeError), and hubspot (expires_in undefined → NaN expiry persisted)
